args.title: Fix off-by-one error in paginate.page()
args.body:
## Summary
Fixed an off-by-one bug in `src/paginate.py` where the `end` index was calculated as `start + size + 1` instead of `start + size`, causing the last item of a page to bleed into the next page.

## Root Cause
The slice end index included an extra `+1`, returning `size+1` items instead of `size` items per page.

## Fix
Changed `end = start + size + 1` to `end = start + size` in the `page()` function.

## Testing
The test `tests/test_paginate.py::test_page_size_is_exact` now passes.
